chunks: My father narrated to him, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Sahl ibn Ziyad al-Adamy, saying: Abu al-Hasan Umar ibn Sufyan al-Gorjany linked the narration up to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),

He said to one of his freedmen: 'O so-and-so, why did you not go out?' He replied: 'May I be your ransom, today is Sunday.' He asked: 'What is wrong with Sunday?' The man said: 'Because of the narration that came from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: 'Beware of Sunday, for it has a boundary like the boundary of a sword.' He said: 'They lied, they lied. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) did not say that, for 'Ahad' (One) is one of the Names of God, the Exalted.' I said: 'May I be your ransom, what about Monday?' He said: 'It was named after those two.' The man said: 'It was named after those two, yet they did not exist.' Abu Abdillah said to him: 'When you are told something, understand it! Indeed, God, the Blessed and Exalted, knew the day on which He would take His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) back, and the day on which His Trustee would be oppressed, so He named it after those two.'

I said: 'What about Tuesday?' He said: 'Hell was created on Tuesday, and that is His saying, the Exalted: "Go to that which you used to deny. Go to a shadow of three columns, which yields no shade and does not protect from the flame."'
"Go to that which you used to deny. Go to a shadow of three columns, which yields no shade and does not protect from the flame."

I said: 'What about Wednesday?' He said: 'The four pillars of Hell were built on Wednesday.' I said: 'What about Thursday?' He said: 'God created Paradise on Thursday.' I said: 'What about Friday?' He said: 'God, the Exalted, gathered the creation for our Wilayah (guardianship) on Friday.' I said: 'What about Saturday?' He said: 'The angels attended to their Lord on Saturday and found that He had always been One.'
ai.seo_question: What is the theological significance of the names of the days of the week in Shia tradition according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) refutes the superstition of 'Sunday's danger' by reinterpreting the etymology of the days through divine attributes and cosmic events. He links Monday and Tuesday to the Prophet and his successor, while assigning Tuesday to the creation of Hell and Wednesday to its structural pillars, thereby grounding the week's significance in Shia theological concepts of Wilayah and divine unity.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-62 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Sahl ibn Zyad al-Adamy, on the authority of Abul Hassan Amr ibn Sufyan al-Gorjany who linked it up through a chain of narrators to Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), “As-Sadiq (MGB) asked one of his friends, ‘O so and so! Why you did you not go out today?’ He replied, ‘May I be your ransom! Because it is Sunday.’ The Imam (MGB) asked him, ‘So what? What is wrong with Sunday?’ The man said, ‘It has been narrated on the authority of God’s Prophet (MGB) to have said, ‘Beware of Sundays as they are as sharp as a sword!’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘No that is not so. They have lied about the Prophet (MGB) having said that since Ahad which means Sunday is one of the Names of the Honorable the Exalted God.’ The man said, ‘May I be your ransom! What about Mondays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘It has been named after those two.’ The man said, ‘But Monday was known as Monday before those two.’ Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) told him, ‘Once you are told something try to understand it! Indeed the Blessed the Sublime God already knew the day on which He would appoint His Prophet (MGB), and the day on which the Prophet’s Trustee (MGB) would be oppressed. Thus, it was named after those two.’

The man said, ‘What about Tuesdays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘God created Hell on a Tuesday as the Sublime God says, ‘(It will be said,) ‘Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false! Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns, (Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.’”
The man said, ‘What about Wednesdays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘The four pillars of Fire were made on a Wednesday.’
The man said, ‘What about Thursdays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘God created Paradise on a Thursday.’

The man said, ‘What about Fridays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘The Honorable the Exalted God gathered the people together on Fridays to acknowledge our Mastery.’The man said, ‘What about Saturdays?’ The Imam (MGB) said, ‘It was on a Saturday that the angels attended to their Lord and realized that He has always been the One.’”
